title: Quick Brined Polish Scallion Frittata
description: A dense and winey Polish dish featuring scallions, perfect for brunch, made with a quick brine and macrobiotic-friendly ingredients.

ingredients.name: brine
ingredients.notes: dry white wine and water mixture

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and dried dill.
Add the chopped scallions to the egg mixture and stir to combine.
Heat the olive oil in a 10-inch oven-safe skillet over medium heat.
Pour the egg mixture into the skillet and cook for 2 minutes.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15 minutes.
While the frittata is baking, prepare the quick brine by mixing the dry white wine and water in a small bowl.
After the frittata has baked for 15 minutes, remove it from the oven and brush the quick brine mixture evenly over the top.
Return the skillet to the oven and bake for an additional 5 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let the frittata cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
